title: The names: NaoMuse on the Mac's screens, DriveGen on the phone, the internal ids unchanged, “Hey NaoMuse” wakes it

steps.why: The Mac app's name and window title
Its internal id stays (what other devices see)

steps.js: ['Hey NaoMuse, what time is it', 'hey nao muse what time', 'Hey now muse what time', 'ok studio gen open maps'].map(t => Chat.wakeRe().test(t)).join()
